nodes.text: Left Behind Friday 🧤 Today's prompt is the things we leave behind - lost, forgotten, waiting to be found again. Mine is a worn longboard sitting in the leaves, still waiting for its rider. Show me ONE photo of something left behind: a lost glove, a lone shoe, a bike chained to nothing, a toy in the park. Replying is consent: • Top 5 featured tomorrow on Threads, pinned • Top 3 also in the Instagram reel • Full credit to the author everywhere • Standouts may join a best-of-the-week reel
photos: Description: A worn skateboard rests on a paved surface, surrounded by out-of-focus green and yellow foliage in the background. Photograph read: The image features a shallow depth of field with the skateboard in focus, while the background is softly blurred. Lighting appears natural and diffused, casting no harsh shadows. The rendering preserves texture on the skateboard’s deck and wheels, though the background remains indistinct. Photo type: Natural

Description: An abandoned, rusted vintage car with missing panels and a broken windshield sits in a forested area, surrounded by fallen leaves and trees, with a large fallen log resting across its roof. Photograph read: The image is captured in natural daylight with even illumination across the scene. The composition centers the car, with trees framing the sides and background. The rendering preserves surface textures and details of the car’s rust and surrounding foliage, with no visible signs of motion blur or focus issues. Photo type: Documentary

replies.text: During the Roman times, a worker in Algeria left his handprint in some construction. Found centuries later, it now hangs in the museum in Tipaza.
photos: Description: A handprint impression is embedded in a textured, light-colored wall surface, showing the palm and five fingers with visible creases and contours. Photograph read: The image is a close-up with even, diffuse lighting that casts minimal shadows, revealing surface texture and the handprint’s contours. The resolution is sufficient to discern the handprint’s shape and fine details like finger joints and palm lines. Photo type: Documentary

replies.text: Left behind.
photos: Description: A tattered, gray fabric garment hangs from a wire mesh fence with barbed wire above, against a light pink concrete block wall, with dry grass visible at the base. Photograph read: The image is in focus with even, diffuse lighting. The fence and wall are clearly rendered, and the fabric’s texture, tears, and stains are visible. No motion blur, overexposure, or underexposure is apparent. Photo type: Documentary

Description: A corroded, seaweed-covered electric scooter lies on a paved dock beside calm water, with a floating barrier and distant railing visible in the background. Photograph read: The image is taken in bright daylight with strong contrast between the dark, wet scooter and the sunlit pavement. The subject is in focus, but the water surface shows natural ripples and reflections. The composition is straightforward, with the scooter centered in the frame. Photo type: Documentary

Description: A narrow, irregularly shaped opening in a weathered stone wall, with a large, broken stone slab leaning against the interior, and a dark bottle visible inside the opening. Photograph read: The image is composed with the stone wall occupying the entire frame, showing layered, rough-textured stones. Lighting is flat and diffuse, with no strong directional highlights or shadows. The rendering preserves the texture of the stones and the bottle, but lacks sharpness or contrast. Photo type: Documentary
watch_outs: The interior of the opening is dark, obscuring fine details of the bottle and the wall’s inner surface. The broken stone slab is partially obscured by shadow and texture, limiting visibility of its shape and surface condition.

replies.text: A little bottle tucked into the wall's dark window, a tin sheet for a curtain. Somebody left it there on purpose - what was it keeping?
Someone left their stuffed animal on the bench while enjoying a sit down with a big dog.
photos: Description: An orange, stylized bear sculpture with a light blue scarf sits on a bench beside a large, plaid-patterned spherical object. The background shows blurred outdoor seating and foliage under warm ambient lighting. Photograph read: The image is taken at an angle, with the bear sculpture as the main subject. Lighting appears to be artificial, casting soft highlights on the sculpture’s glossy surface. The background is out of focus, and the bench’s wooden slats are visible but not sharply defined. Photo type: Street photography
watch_outs: The background is significantly blurred, obscuring details of the surrounding environment. The plaid sphere’s surface has visible texture and pattern, but the edges are not sharply defined, suggesting limited depth of field or slight focus softness.

replies.text: The little one at the end of the bench, keeping the big dog company while the evening lights come on. I hope its owner comes back for it.
One of many items left behind at an abandoned homeless camp.
photos: Description: A partially decomposed Mickey Mouse costume lies among dry leaves and pine needles on the forest floor, with visible wear and discoloration. Photograph read: The image is taken from a high angle, with natural, diffused lighting. The costume’s red and yellow features are visible but faded, and the surrounding foliage is in focus. The texture of the leaves and needles is discernible, but the costume’s fabric shows creases and dirt. Photo type: Documentary

replies.text: That Mickey print, half-buried in the leaves - a small bright thing in a heavy place. Thanks for looking closely enough to see it.

photos: Description: Two apples, one green and one red, are positioned side-by-side on a flat surface with a blurred background featuring a grid-like pattern. Photograph read: The apples are in focus with visible surface texture and specular highlights. Lighting is direct and even, casting soft shadows. The background is out of focus, with no discernible depth of field beyond the foreground subjects. Photo type: Still life

replies.text: Two apples left on the desk, green and red side by side like they are keeping each other company. Who walked away from lunch, do you think?

photos: Description: Two green propane tanks with black caps sit on concrete pads outdoors, adjacent to a dark brown building wall and bare-branched shrubs, under bright daylight. Photograph read: The image is taken in direct sunlight, casting sharp shadows. The tanks and surrounding gravel are in clear focus, with no visible motion blur or focus falloff. The composition is straightforward, with the tanks centered in the frame and the building and shrubs forming a simple backdrop. Photo type: Documentary

replies.text: Hull of the ship sunk by Pear Harbor attack.
photos: Description: The photograph shows the stern of the USS Arizona BB 39, a battleship, floating in water with a tree-covered island and distant shoreline in the background under a cloudy sky. Photograph read: The image has a grainy texture and visible pixelation, with muted colors and soft contrast. The ship’s name is legible but slightly faded, and the water surface shows gentle ripples. The sky is overcast, and the distant landmass is hazy. Photo type: Vintage print
watch_outs: - The entire image exhibits visible grain and pixelation, reducing fine detail across the entire frame. - The ship’s nameplate is partially worn, with faded lettering and minor chipping, limiting legibility of the text.

replies.text: The name still reads clear across the water, all these years on. Is this from a visit, or an old family print?

photos: Description: An abandoned, rusted vintage car with missing panels and interior components sits in a dirt yard beside a concrete block wall, surrounded by trees with yellowing leaves. Photograph read: The image is taken in natural daylight with even illumination; the car and surrounding foliage are in focus, though details are not sharply defined. The composition places the car centrally, with trees framing the sides and a wall behind. No visible signs of motion blur, lens distortion, or chromatic aberration. Photo type: Documentary

replies.text: That old car has settled right into the yard, trees and all, like the place grew up around it. What do you think its last drive was?
Abandoned at the beach
photos: Description: A small, weathered wooden toy train car with red wheels and faded blue paint sits atop a rough, textured tree stump. In the blurred background, white and gray waves are visible, suggesting a coastal or shoreline setting. Photograph read: The image is taken with a shallow depth of field, keeping the toy car in focus while the background and foreground stump surface are softly blurred. Lighting appears natural and diffused, casting minimal shadows. The image has a slightly grainy or noisy texture, and the colors are muted. Photo type: Documentary
watch_outs: The background waves are indistinct and blurred, obscuring any fine detail or texture. The toy car’s paint and markings are partially worn and faded, reducing legibility of the number “409” and other graphics.

replies.text: A little red-wheeled train left on a stump, waves behind it, paint worn down to the wood. Somebody's favorite once - I wonder how long it has been sitting there.
Ah! I have one...
photos: Description: A plush pig with white fur and dark spots rests on the top of a weathered wooden fence post, with a residential street and a concrete wall in the background under clear skies. Photograph read: The image is taken in bright daylight with natural lighting, showing a shallow depth of field that blurs the background. The foreground fence and plush pig are in focus, while the background houses and foliage are softly out of focus. The pig’s features are discernible, but the texture of the fence and surrounding environment is not sharply defined. Photo type: Portrait

replies.text: A spotted pig, perched on a fence post like it owns the street. Did it climb up there itself, or did someone give it the best seat?
I put it up there so it would be more visible to the little one who might be looking for it. I figured it fell out of a stroller. As a mom, I have lived this drama first hand🙂
DFW, Rental Car Shuttle Bus
photos: Description: A single black high-heeled boot is positioned on a rough concrete surface, with a blurred background of a road, guardrails, and distant trees. Photograph read: The image is taken from a low angle, with the boot in sharp focus against a softly blurred background. Lighting appears to be natural daylight, casting subtle shadows. The image has a shallow depth of field, with the background rendered indistinct. Photo type: Portrait

replies.text: One boot, on its own by the shuttle bus, with the road going nowhere behind it. Whose night ended there?

photos: Description: A skier in a bright orange jacket and helmet navigates a slalom course marked by blue and red poles on a snowy slope, with dense evergreen forests and a mountain range in the background under clear blue skies. Photograph read: The image is taken from a slightly elevated angle, capturing the skier mid-turn. Lighting is bright and direct, casting clear shadows. The snow surface shows tracks and some texture, while the background is sharply defined. The skier’s motion is evident from the slight blur of poles and skis. Photo type: Action sports

Description: A bicycle with a black frame, red-rimmed rear wheel, and a heart-shaped seat is parked against a weathered wooden fence, with a potted plant to its right on a concrete slab. Photograph read: The image is rendered with a warm color cast and moderate contrast, showing clear textures on the wood fence and bicycle components. The composition is static, with the bicycle occupying the left side and the plant on the right, both resting on a ground covered in dry leaves. Photo type: Aesthetic

replies.text: Parked against the fence with the leaves piling up around it, like it has been waiting a while. Does it still get ridden, or is the fence its home now?

When I went to Japan I stayed with friends I got a message that I had left an jacket and a towel at their house . They have a phrase for that - The things we left behind" in Japanese can be translated as 私たちが残したもの (watashitachi ga nokoshita mono)
A jacket and a towel, and a whole phrase for the things we leave behind. I like that there is a name for it - did they send them back to you, or are they still waiting in Japan?
Luckily his parents are friends and we’re visiting him later I told them to use the towel but I world have the jacket back

photos: Description: A crushed aluminum can of Dr Pepper sits on a wooden surface next to a partially opened pink cardboard box of “Urban Eat” egg mayo and bacon, and a green-wrapped Wrigley’s Juicy Fruit candy bar. A black bag strap is visible to the left. Photograph read: The image is taken from a slightly elevated angle, with direct lighting casting clear shadows. The can and packaging are in focus, with visible text and details. The background includes a white countertop and a white wall, with no signs of motion blur or focus issues. Photo type: Documentary

replies.text: The whole lunch, left exactly where it ended - can open, sandwich box empty, gum for the road. What made its owner walk away mid-bite?
Abandoned casa in Bella Vista Calabria
photos: Description: A weathered, two-story building with a rusted balcony and a dark wooden door stands at the end of a narrow, cobblestone alleyway, flanked by other residential structures. Photograph read: The image is taken in bright daylight with clear visibility of textures and architectural details. The composition is straightforward, with the building centered and the alley receding into the background. Shadows are present but not obscuring, and the image lacks signs of motion blur or focus issues. Photo type: Documentary

replies.text: A whole house, left at the end of a narrow alley with its shutters hanging. I think the rust on that old railing tells the story better than any plaque - how did you find your way to it?
This is a similar house on the Via Bella Vista which has been beautifully restored
photos: Description: A narrow street corner features a two-story building with a white door, a balcony adorned with hanging flower pots, and a large tiled mural depicting a knight on horseback defeating a dragon. The building has an orange-yellow facade, a blue window frame, and a green mailbox. Photograph read: The image is taken from a low angle looking up the street, with the building’s facade and entrance centered. Lighting appears even and diffused, suggesting an overcast day. The photograph has a standard digital resolution, with no visible signs of motion blur, chromatic aberration, or sensor noise. Photo type: Urban architecture

replies.text: When in Pizzo, I pass it on my walk down to the Piazza
Untouched for 30 years.
photos: Description: A red bicycle with a round red helmet mounted on the handlebars is positioned against a textured wall, with a brick or block wall visible to the right and a rough floor beneath. Photograph read: The image has a warm, high-contrast color cast with visible grain or texture. Lighting is directional, casting strong shadows and highlighting the bike’s frame and wheels. The composition is a side profile, with the bike leaning against a vertical surface. Photo type: Aesthetic

replies.text: Thirty years untouched, helmet still on the handlebars like its rider just stepped off for a minute. Some waits are longer than others - whose bike is it?
It was my wife’s . It’s been sitting upstairs in the barn at her parent’s place.

photos: Description: The photograph shows footprints in wet sand on a beach, with waves breaking at the shoreline and a dark sky above the ocean. Photograph read: The foreground sand and footprints are in focus, while the ocean and sky are softly blurred. Lighting is even, suggesting daylight, with no visible shadows or harsh contrast. The image has a shallow depth of field, emphasizing the footprints. Photo type: Natural

replies.text: Four prints in the sand, and the sea already on its way to take them. I like that the photo caught them just before they were gone.

photos: Description: A black leather wallet with light-colored stitching rests on a wooden surface with visible grain. Photograph read: The image is taken from a slightly elevated angle, with even, diffuse lighting that highlights the wallet’s surface and stitching. The rendering is clear, with no visible motion blur or focus issues. Photo type: Still life

replies.text: A wallet, left on the wood with nothing else around it. Somebody is patting their pockets somewhere right now - did it find its way home?
Yeah. Found before we left.

photos: Description: A blue bicycle lies on its side on a concrete sidewalk, with its shadow cast prominently nearby. The sidewalk extends into the distance, flanked by grassy areas and trees, with a pedestrian crossing sign visible in the background. Photograph read: The image is taken in bright daylight, with strong contrast between the sidewalk and surrounding grass. The bicycle and its shadow are in sharp focus, while the background shows some atmospheric haze and slight softness. The color saturation is elevated, particularly in the sky and foliage. Photo type: Saturated

replies.text: The shadow doubles it, so for a second there are two bikes lying on the sidewalk. Did its rider just hop off and forget it, or is this its regular parking spot?
Good question...😆 At first I just saw the bike, the shadow second, when I was getting ready to take the picture. I was happy with the result. 🤗
A happy accident, and a keeper. Thanks for telling the story behind it.
Lobster traps left behind for the next season. Scotland.
photos: Description: The foreground features a pile of tangled fishing nets and ropes on grass, with a body of water and a distant castle on an island in the background, set against rolling hills under a cloudy sky. Photograph read: The composition layers the nets in the foreground against the water and castle in the midground, with a cloudy sky above. Lighting is diffuse, with muted tones and visible texture in the nets. The image has a slightly enhanced color saturation and contrast, with visible grain or digital noise in the foreground. Photo type: Landscape
watch_outs: Foreground nets: fine details of the rope texture and net weave are visible but not sharply defined, with some areas appearing slightly soft or indistinct. Background castle: distant and partially obscured by atmospheric haze, reducing edge definition and detail clarity.

replies.text: A whole fleet of traps on holiday, ropes and all, with the castle across the water keeping watch. When do they go back in?
The season in the Scottish lochs is from June through September. This photo was taken in early October. And yes, the remarkable Eilean Donan castle stands guard in the background.
Early October light and a castle on watch - a fine end to the season. Thanks for the story.

photos: Description: A worn work glove is mounted on a white pole, positioned outdoors with a grassy area, a concrete path, and a distant treeline under a bright sun in the background. Photograph read: The image is taken in bright, direct sunlight with a shallow depth of field, causing the background to be softly blurred. The glove is in focus and well-lit, but the pole and foreground grass show minimal texture detail. The sun’s glare is visible at the top right, creating a bright wash. Photo type: Outdoor portrait
watch_outs: The glove’s fingers are frayed and torn, with visible wear and dirt, limiting the clarity of its original condition. The top right corner is overexposed, obscuring fine detail in the sky and horizon.

replies.text: Somebody lost a glove and somebody else gave it the best seat in the field. Now it waves at every sunset.
Tyres at beach
photos: Description: Two discarded car wheels, one with a rusted steel rim and the other with a more corroded, possibly aluminum rim, lie on sandy ground next to a concrete curb, with sparse green grass nearby. Photograph read: The image is in focus with even, natural lighting, capturing fine details on the tires and rust patterns. The composition places the wheels in the foreground, with a shallow depth of field blurring the background pavement and curb. Photo type: Documentary
watch_outs: - The tire tread and sidewall text on the front wheel are partially legible but not fully readable due to wear and dirt. - The rust patterns on the rims are visible but not sharply defined, with some areas obscured by surface texture and debris.

replies.text: I think the rusty rim makes the shot - two tyres left at the beach, leaning on the curb, suddenly a portrait. How long had they been sitting there when you found them?
The rust makes you feel like they’d been there ages. I’ve no idea how long they were there for, I just thought it was such an unusual place for them to be.
A strange spot for them, and all the better for it. Thanks for sharing the find.

photos: Description: A yellow and black toy excavator rests on wet sand near the water’s edge, surrounded by scattered green seaweed and small debris. Photograph read: The image is taken from a slightly elevated angle, with even, diffused lighting. The focus is centered on the toy, with the background and foreground seaweed slightly out of focus. The sand’s texture is visible, and the water’s surface is shallow and reflective. Photo type: Documentary

replies.text: Did its builder forget it mid-shift, or is the tide its boss now? That little digger is still parked right at the water's edge, seaweed draped over it and all.

photos: Description: A heavy, rusted chain lies coiled on a concrete surface, with a similarly corroded cylindrical metal structure partially visible in the background. Photograph read: The image is in sharp focus, with even lighting that clearly renders the texture and rust patterns on the chain and cylinder. The composition is straightforward, with the chain as the central subject and the cylinder as a background element. Photo type: Documentary

replies.text: That rust is doing half the talking. A whole anchor chain, links and shackles and all, just sitting on the concrete going nowhere - what do you think it used to hold?

photos: Description: A black-and-white photograph shows a small, round, smiling figurine with the word "LOVE" written on its body, positioned among dense, leafy vegetation on the ground. Photograph read: The image is in monochrome, with high contrast between the light-colored figurine and the dark foliage. The figurine is in focus, while the surrounding vegetation is slightly out of focus. Lighting appears natural and even, with no visible shadows or harsh highlights. Photo type: Still Life

Description: A doll with a human-like face and bare torso lies on grass, partially surrounded by blades and small clover-like plants, with one arm extended outward. Photograph read: The image is in black and white, with high contrast between the grass and the doll. The doll is centrally positioned but not sharply focused, and the grass texture is dense and detailed. Lighting appears even, without obvious shadows or highlights. Photo type: Documentary

replies.text: Two goodbyes in one post, and they could not be more different. The smiling LOVE gourd is still cheerful in the weeds, and the doll is flat on its back in the grass like it gave up - which one did you spot first?
The gourd, months apart.
Months apart and still smiling in the weeds - a good eye to catch them both. Thanks for sharing them.
Pollen fingerprints left on a car
photos: Description: The image shows a reflective surface, likely a car's glossy exterior, with reflections of bare tree branches and a bright sky. Faint, rounded white marks are visible on the surface, possibly water droplets or smudges. Photograph read: The composition is dominated by reflections, with the surface acting as a mirror. Lighting appears bright and diffuse, creating clear reflections but also causing glare and minor surface imperfections. Rendering is flat with no discernible depth or texture beyond the reflections. Photo type: Reflections
watch_outs: - Reflections are indistinct and partially obscured by surface marks, reducing clarity of the tree branches and sky. - Surface marks (white, rounded) are visible and interfere with the reflection, making fine detail unreadable in those areas.

replies.text: Three little fingerprints in the pollen, with the bare branches reflected right behind them. Whose hand do you think left them there?

photos: Description: A weathered, cloth-wrapped object with a long, curved horn-like protrusion lies on the ground among green foliage and fallen leaves; the object is partially covered by a translucent, mesh-like fabric. Photograph read: The image is taken from a high angle, with natural daylight illuminating the scene. The subject is in focus, though the surrounding vegetation and ground cover show some natural texture and depth. The mesh fabric has visible stitching and slight fraying, and a dry leaf is caught within it. Photo type: Documentary

replies.text: That tulle dress, all greyed and tangled in the ivy, and one little arm reaching out. How long do you think she has been waiting out there?
I imagined a little Victorian girl wandering tearfully around the park with an empty pram...
That little story stays with the photo now. Thanks for sharing it.
You are welcome 😁

photos: Description: A small, golden-colored Ganesha statue sits on sandy beach near a fallen pink flower, with a greenish object partially buried nearby; the calm sea and cloudy sky stretch to the horizon. Photograph read: The image is taken from a low angle, with even, diffused lighting from an overcast sky. The foreground elements are in focus, while the midground beach and distant water show gentle motion blur. The horizon is soft and slightly hazy. Photo type: Natural

replies.text: The statue on the sand, pink flowers beside it, the sea right behind - it feels like a small farewell left on the beach. Did you see it placed there, or find it after?
There must have been a ￼beach celebration prior, but I just came across this on a lovely Chicago summer morning.￼
That is exactly the kind of morning find worth keeping. Thanks for sharing it.

photos: Description: The photograph shows a cluster of dry, brown oak leaves clinging to a thin branch against a backdrop of bare tree limbs and a vivid blue sky. Some distant green foliage is visible at the bottom. Photograph read: The image is taken from a low angle looking upward, with the main subject (leaves) in relatively sharp focus. The background trees are softly blurred, creating depth. Lighting is bright and direct, casting clear shadows and highlighting the texture of the leaves and branches. The sky is uniformly saturated blue. Photo type: Nature portrait

replies.text: A whole branch gone bare and these few brown leaves still hanging on like they missed the memo. Did they get left behind, or are they just the stubborn ones?
I like your philosophical approach 🍂
Thank you. I wish it makes every day life more interesting 😉
An Inukshuk in Nova Scotia
photos: Description: A balanced stone structure, resembling an inukshuk, is constructed from five rocks and stands on a larger granite base, with a blurred background of water and rocky terrain. Photograph read: The image is a close-up shot with a shallow depth of field, keeping the inukshuk in focus while the background is softly blurred. Lighting is even and diffused, suggesting an overcast day. The rendering preserves surface textures of the stones, but lacks sharpness in the background elements. Photo type: Natural landscape
watch_outs: The background is significantly out of focus, obscuring details of the shoreline and water. The topmost stone’s surface texture is partially obscured by the shallow depth of field, reducing fine-grain visibility.

replies.text: Did you find it standing there, or stack it stone by stone? Either way, five rocks balanced against the water is a patient kind of hello.
It was standing there, on the boulders, with other Inukshuks around them.
A whole gathering of them, then - good thing you stopped to look. Thanks for the story behind it.

photos: Description: The image shows a close-up of tangled, pale, fibrous plant material, with a small, round, brownish object partially obscured among the strands. Some darker green leaves and stems are visible in the background. Photograph read: The composition is dense with overlapping strands, creating a cluttered visual field. Lighting is uneven, with some areas brightly illuminated and others in shadow, suggesting an outdoor or ambient light source. The image lacks sharpness, with no discernible focal plane. Photo type: Unclear
watch_outs: - The main subject (the round object) is partially obscured by the fibrous material, making its features indistinct. - The overall image exhibits soft focus, reducing the visibility of fine texture and detail across the entire frame.

photos: Description: A pair of dark, high-heeled shoes lies on a cracked asphalt surface next to a metal pole, with a crumpled green plastic bottle nearby and a partially visible poster in the upper left corner. Photograph read: The image is taken from a high angle, with direct sunlight casting sharp shadows. The surface texture of the asphalt and the details of the shoes are visible, though the shoes show signs of wear and damage. The poster’s text is partially legible but not fully readable. Photo type: Documentary
watch_outs: - The right shoe is open and damaged, with the inner lining exposed, limiting the visibility of its internal structure. - The poster’s text is partially obscured by angle and resolution, making full readability impossible.

replies.text: Two heels on cracked asphalt, one coming apart at the seams, a crumpled bottle keeping them company. Whose night ended here, and did you see any of it?
Forgotten chair...
photos: Description: A gray upholstered armchair with nailhead trim sits against a textured brick wall in a dimly lit interior space, with a dining area and hanging lights visible in the background. Photograph read: The image is rendered in monochrome with soft, directional lighting from above and the left, casting shadows on the chair and wall. The composition places the chair as the central subject, with the background slightly out of focus. The brick wall shows clear texture, and the chair’s fabric has visible folds and stitching. Photo type: Interior portrait

replies.text: I think the nailhead trim is what gets me - somebody chose that chair once, carefully, and now it waits against a brick wall. What do you think it is waiting for?
For someone !!
For someone, then - a chair with a job still ahead of it. Thanks for the answer.
It's my pleasure

photos: Description: A line of mules, harnessed together, stands in a field with a green agricultural machine behind them; the field is dry and brown, with sparse green patches, and a pale sky with distant trees. Photograph read: The image is taken from a low angle, with even, diffused lighting. The mules and machine are in focus, but the foreground field is slightly out of focus. The composition places the subjects centrally, with a shallow depth of field blurring the distant background. Photo type: Documentary

Description: A group of people in yellow rain ponchos stands on a wet viewing platform overlooking the powerful, misty Niagara Falls, with a tour boat visible on the turbulent water below. Photograph read: The image is taken from an elevated position, capturing the falls and the group in the foreground. Lighting is diffuse and even, characteristic of an overcast sky, with no harsh shadows. The image has a moderate level of detail, though the mist from the falls reduces contrast and sharpness in the background. Photo type: Documentary

Description: A collection of red and yellow hard hats arranged in a loose cluster on a textured, dark gray surface with visible paint splatters and drips. Photograph read: The image is a flat, direct overhead shot with even, diffuse lighting. The hard hats are rendered with smooth surfaces and distinct color gradients, while the background shows vertical streaks and splashes of red and white paint. Photo type: Still life

Description: A hand holds a corroded, rusted metal object featuring a small glass bottle, a pair of scissors, and a coiled wire, set against a blurred outdoor grassy and earthy background. Photograph read: The image is taken in bright daylight with natural lighting; the subject is in focus but the background is softly blurred. The rendering preserves surface textures and rust patterns, though some fine details are indistinct due to shallow depth of field. Photo type: Documentary

Description: A circular arrangement of assorted seashells and a starfish rests on a dark, textured surface, possibly concrete or damp sand, with some shells embedded in soil. Photograph read: The image is taken from a high angle, with strong directional lighting casting sharp shadows. The shells and starfish are in focus, but the overall image has a slightly grainy or noisy appearance. The surface beneath shows visible texture and unevenness. Photo type: Natural
watch_outs: - The bottle’s surface is partially obscured by rust and the wire, limiting visibility of its original condition. - The background blur (bokeh) reduces context clarity, making the setting indistinct.

replies.text: Stunning picks 👌 👏
Thank you Dee!
My pleasure Saars 🙏
@wj.fox Your mule team opens the Gathered Thursday favorites - ten mules hitched to the seeder, every face turned to the camera. How long have you been working with a team like this?
Thank you

This team actually had fourteen mules and this photo was taken on an Amish Farm in Lebanon, Pennsylvania. I’ve been taking photos of Amish and Mennonite Farming activities for two years. Just this past several months I was approached by two seperate Amish Farmers, who wanted me to take mule photos for them so that they could be used in a calendar just showing mules. I was given access to their farms so that I could photograph their mules, the fourteen mule photos were shot November 4th 2026.

@tallymountain Slide two of the Gathered Thursday favorites is your crowd in yellow ponchos gathered at the railing, the falls pouring behind them. How close does that platform actually get you to the water?

Quite close, I could see behind the falls where I was standing and there is a tunnel you can go through that takes you right in behind the falls. Awesome experience and I got some cool photos of it. The bulk of water is phenomenal.
Thank you for sharing it with us. There are so many different ways to watch Niagara Falls 🙏
@jh1962bike The middle slide of the Gathered Thursday favorites is your hard hats in reds and oranges gathered on a weathered wall. Whose hats are they, and where does that wall live?
The hats were on a construction site in central Frankfurt . I guess they belong to the workers who were completing the skyscraper .
They look so artistic! Thank you for sharing the photo!

@dianelynnturnbull Slide four of the Gathered Thursday favorites is your handful of rusted finds from the fire cleanup, the scissors still riding on top. How long did that cleanup take, working through it piece by piece?

I suspect that we will be finding treasures such as these for many years to come. We spent about 6 months clearing out the once densly wooded 8 or so acres where I found this particular handful of rusted tools and trinkets, with the support of hundreds of volunteers and contractors. I run a camp for adults with developmental and physical disabilities and I was determined to not let a summer go by without having campers here. We did it. There's nothing better than happy campers.
Wow ~ thank you for sharing such a wonderful story with us by your photos 🙏

@artiekay2 Your granddaughter's seashell mandala closes the Gathered Thursday favorites - every shell placed, starfish at the center. Did she lay it out in one sitting, or did it grow shell by shell over the day?
Thank you for recognizing my granddaughter’s art. She made this in one sitting.
Thank you for sharing the warm story with us 🙏
